platform/auto_forward_enabled_gamepad_de:
^$Off:^7 Pushing the movement stick (left by default) forward will not make you continuously move forward.

^$Single Tap:^7 Pushing the stick forward ^$once^7 will make you continuously move forward. Pull it backwards to stop. Sprinting does not interrupt auto move forward.

platform/automatic_sprint_gamepad_desc:
^$^BOff:^R^7 Sprint is activated manually with the Sprint button.

^$^BAutomatic Sprint:^R^7 Move Forward while standing to automatically sprint. Press the Sprint button twice in quick succession while sprinting to activate Tactical Sprint.

^$^BAutomatic Tactical Sprint:^R^7 Move Forward while standing to automatically activate Tactical Sprint.

Automatic Sprint will not change your current stance (e.g.: crouched, prone) and will not cancel other actions in progress (e.g.: reloading, aiming down sights).
platform/automatic_sprint_kbm_desc:
^$^BOff:^R^7 Sprint is activated manually with any Sprint ([{kbm:breath_sprint}]) keybind.

^$^BAutomatic Sprint:^R^7 Press ^$Move Forward^7 ([{kbm:+forward}]) while standing to automatically sprint. Press any Sprint or Tactical Sprint ([{kbm:breath_sprint}]) keybind while sprinting to activate the Tactical Sprint.

^$^BAutomatic Tactical Sprint:^R^7 Press ^$Move Forward^7 ([{kbm:+forward}]) while standing to automatically activate Tactical Sprint.

Automatic Sprint will not change your current stance (e.g.: crouched, prone) and will not cancel other actions in progress (e.g.: reloading, aiming down sights). Walking ([{kbm:+walk}]) has priority over Automatic Sprint.
